"""RoboCasa GR1 PnPBottleToCabinetClose: hand-written Cartesian attempt.

The service owns the simulator. This script uses only Robot observations and
its proprioception; it does not load benchmark state, demonstrations, or policy
weights. Pose channels are expressed in the GR1 base frame. The calibration
below was inferred from the initial eef positions and initial pose commands.
"""
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

DT = 0.05
# World-to-base position transform inferred from initial live proprioception:
# local x -> world +y, local y -> world -x, local z -> world +z.
BASE_WORLD = np.array([2.650, -2.175, 0.970])

def world_to_base(p):
    x, y, z = np.asarray(p, dtype=float)
    return np.array([y + 2.175, 2.650 - x, z - 0.970])

def interp_rows(right_pose, left_pose, left_target, n, hand=(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)):
    a = np.zeros((n, 24), dtype=np.float64)
    a[:, :6] = right_pose
    a[:, 6:12] = left_pose + np.arange(1, n + 1)[:, None] / n * (left_target - left_pose)
    a[:, 18:24] = np.asarray(hand, dtype=float)
    return a

def pose_from_now(now):
    return now[84:90].copy(), now[90:96].copy()

def main():
    robot = Robot()
    cameras = ["egoview", "robot0_agentview_center", "robot0_agentview_left"]
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=True, video="none")
    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    right_pose, left_pose = pose_from_now(now)
    orient = left_pose[3:].copy()

    def left_waypoint(local_xyz, steps=24, hand=(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0), note=""):
        nonlocal left_pose
        target = np.r_[np.asarray(local_xyz, dtype=float), orient]
        result = robot.submit(
            "ee_pose", interp_rows(right_pose, left_pose, target, steps, hand),
            cameras=cameras, video="none", note=note)
        left_pose = target
        return result

    # Visual estimate from the live camera: bottle on counter near world
    # (2.35, -1.90, 1.04); open cabinet ahead near (2.6, -1.5, 1.2+).
    # Approach above the bottle, lower, close the Fourier hand, and test a lift.
    left_waypoint(world_to_base((2.35, -1.90, 1.17)), 40,
                  note="pregrasp above bottle")
    left_waypoint(world_to_base((2.35, -1.90, 1.06)), 24,
                  note="lower open hand")
    left_waypoint(world_to_base((2.35, -1.90, 1.06)), 20,
                  hand=(3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 1), note="close fingers and oppose thumb")
    left_waypoint(world_to_base((2.35, -1.90, 1.20)), 30,
                  hand=(3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 1), note="lift test")

    # If the bottle has rolled, use the camera estimate and a low Cartesian
    # sweep toward the cabinet opening. Reobserve before attempting to close it.
    left_waypoint(world_to_base((2.25, -1.95, 1.00)), 24,
                  note="reposition behind bottle")
    left_waypoint(world_to_base((2.56, -1.58, 1.18)), 30,
                  note="push toward cabinet shelf")
    robot.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=True, video="none").save("/app/runs/gen_final_observation")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
